mauritius_warning.summary: At 13h00, the Tropical Cyclone Belal was centred at about 170 km almost to the west of Le Morne near latitude 21.1 degrees south and longitude 55.9 degrees east. It is moving towards the east-south-east at a speed of about 12 km/h. On this trajectory Belal is dangerously approaching Mauritius and it represents a direct threat for Mauritius. The radius of cyclonic winds is likely to cross the southern part of the island and Belal is expected to pass closer to the south of the island early tomorrow morning.

storms.name: Belal
storms.summary: Belal (historical advisory (demo), max wind 158 km/h) is 233 km from Mauritius, moving ESE at 19 km/h. Forecast landfall: Reunion near Saint-Denis (Reunion), Mon 15 Jan ~16:30 Mauritius time (in 3 h). Closest to Mauritius: 187 km, Tue 16 Jan ~04:30 (in 15 h). Mauritius lies inside the forecast zone for gale-force winds (63+ km/h).
